system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

Case: SHARP NCT00125593 - Study of Heart and Renal Protection | mode: autopsy | as_of: 2010-11-20
Drug: simvastatin (HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor)

Verdict: {"outcome": "success", "outcome_basis": "readout: \"VYTORIN (ezetimibe/simvastatin) Significantly Reduced Major Vascular Events in Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease in a New 9,000-Patient I\" (announcement:sharp)", "predicted_outcome": "success", "consistency": "consistent with the calculator (probability of success 83%)", "primary_category": "narrow_success", "secondary_categories": [], "calculator_category": "narrow_success", "confidence": "medium", "verification": "done", "probability_of_success": 0.829, "weakest_link": "target genetics: uncertain"}
Calculator: {"case_id": "sharp", "ldl_equivalent_mmol": 0.6, "basis": "LDL-C", "time_factor": 0.988, "expected_hr": 0.863, "causal_rrr": 0.137, "bp_factor": 1.0, "power": 0.829, "mde_hr_80": 0.868, "outcome": "success", "category": "narrow_success", "secondary": [], "weakest_link": "target genetics: uncertain", "consistent_with_observed": null, "assumptions": ["LDL-C: no baseline given, assumed 2.0"], "notes": []}
Hypotheses: {"hypotheses": [{"category": "narrow_success", "status": "supported", "for": [{"text": "Primary endpoint met with statistical significance: HR 0.839 (16.1% RRR), p=0.001 for first major vascular events in 9,438 CKD patients over 4.9 years median follow-up.", "refs": ["f_b0c11f8a21e91d", "f_8b98bf69b1b815", "f_f4cf6e3e76307c", "f_b2b2f16890fcc6", "f_b2bfcbc177c65f"]}, {"text": "LDL-C reduced by 30% (placebo-adjusted) at 2.5 years, consistent with intended biomarker effect.", "refs": ["f_1e0081604972e1", "f_87b72a90517edc"]}, {"text": "Observed benefit (HR 0.839) is slightly smaller than mechanism-predicted HR (~0.816) when using the correct baseline LDL-C of 108 mg/dL (2.79 mmol/L) from the trial announcement, giving an absolute reduction of ~0.84 mmol/L.", "refs": ["f_cc4e234cb7ca67", "f_1e0081604972e1", "calculator"]}], "against": [{"text": "Upper confidence bound for the primary endpoint HR is not available in verified facts, so cannot confirm it is well below 1.0.", "refs": []}, {"text": "Target genetics uncertain: HMGCR genetic association score 0.695 but zero pre-cutoff evidence (all 4 studies post-2010-11-20).", "refs": ["f_53f9433e84f158"]}], "would_settle": "Published 95% CI for the primary endpoint HR; pre-2010 human genetic evidence for HMGCR variants and coronary disease."}, {"category": "success_with_caveats", "status": "weakened", "for": [{"text": "Target genetics uncertain (evidence_before_cutoff=0) is a caveat for causal inference.", "refs": ["f_53f9433e84f158"]}, {"text": "SEAS trial (aortic stenosis) showed a cancer safety signal with simvastatin-ezetimibe, though SHARP itself reported no safety signal.", "refs": ["f_91642bfbd3d950", "f_e2a2995385925e"]}], "against": [{"text": "SHARP's own safety signal fact states '0' (no signal) in the announcement.", "refs": ["f_e2a2995385925e"]}, {"text": "The primary endpoint was met clearly (p=0.001), not marginally; the caveat of uncertain target genetics is already captured as the weakest link in narrow_success.", "refs": ["f_8b98bf69b1b815"]}], "would_settle": "Long-term cancer incidence follow-up from SHARP; Mendelian randomization studies for HMGCR published before 2010."}, {"category": "target_not_causal", "status": "weakened", "for": [{"text": "No pre-2010 genetic evidence linking HMGCR to coronary disease (evidence_before_cutoff=0).", "refs": ["f_53f9433e84f158"]}], "against": [{"text": "HMGCR genetic association score is 0.695 (moderate) based on 4 studies, and LDL-C is well-established as causal for ASCVD via other genetic instruments (e.g., PCSK9, NPC1L1).", "refs": ["f_53f9433e84f158"]}, {"text": "The trial demonstrated a clear clinical benefit consistent with LDL-C lowering.", "refs": ["f_b0c11f8a21e91d", "f_1e0081604972e1"]}], "would_settle": "Pre-2010 Mendelian randomization studies for HMGCR and coronary outcomes."}, {"category": "population", "status": "weakened", "for": [{"text": "CKD patients have high competing non-atherosclerotic cardiovascular risk (e.g., heart failure, arrhythmia) which LDL-lowering may not prevent, potentially diluting the observable benefit.", "refs": ["f_e54b38e67e2b2f"]}], "against": [{"text": "The primary endpoint (first major vascular events) is dominated by atherosclerotic events (MI, stroke, revascularization) that LDL-lowering does prevent.", "refs": ["f_f4cf6e3e76307c", "f_a1e540c1b713cf"]}, {"text": "A clear 16.1% RRR was observed, indicating the mechanism operates in this population.", "refs": ["f_a1e540c1b713cf"]}], "would_settle": "Subgroup analysis of event types in SHARP (atherosclerotic vs. non-atherosclerotic)."}, {"category": "design_or_endpoint", "status": "weakened", "for": [{"text": "Composite endpoint includes revascularization, which can be driven by non-atherosclerotic factors in CKD.", "refs": ["f_f4cf6e3e76307c"]}], "against": [{"text": "Endpoint matches the mechanism (LDL-C lowering prevents atherosclerotic events); the trial was powered for and achieved this endpoint.", "refs": ["f_a1e540c1b713cf", "calculator"]}, {"text": "Follow-up of 4.9 years is adequate for LDL-C lowering benefit to accrue (time_factor 0.988).", "refs": ["f_4120933dee2d16", "calculator"]}], "would_settle": "Component-specific HRs for MI, stroke, and revascularization separately."}], "primary_category": "narrow_success", "secondary_categories": [], "confidence": "medium", "departure_from_calculator": "The calculator's narrow_success was based on an assumed LDL-C baseline of 2.0 mmol/L, yielding expected_hr 0.863 (observed 0.839 better than predicted). Using the verified baseline of 108 mg/dL (2.79 mmol/L) from the trial announcement, the mechanism predicts HR ~0.816, making the observed HR 0.839 slightly worse than predicted. The category remains narrow_success but for the reason 'smaller than the mechanism predicts' rather than 'close to the edge'. The weakest link (target genetics uncertain) is unchanged."}
